title: Harness of Minervini v2 watchlist.show response

as_of.description: Completed US trading session in YYYY-MM-DD form; defaults to the latest completed regular session.

format.description: Output detail only; compact preserves verdict, signals, and missing evidence while omitting verbose basis rows.

limitations: The ledger stores research decisions, not holdings, allocations, quantities, or account values.
--as-of stamps this read; it does not filter the ledger's event history.
x-capability-contract.output: Current ledger records; an absent ledger returns an empty list without creating a database.

status_meanings.ok: Records or a legitimate empty list were returned.

x-capability-contract.summary: Read the latest explicitly recorded research item for each instrument.
